'''Mimi''' is a minor character who appeared in ''[[M15|Kyurem VS. The Sword of Justice]]''.

He was sitting with his family aboard the same train as {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, when {{AP|Pikachu}}, {{AP|Oshawott}}, {{AP|Scraggy}}, and {{TP|Iris|Axew}} ran through their section, much to their delight. While Ash and his friends visited [[Malin]]'s food stall as the train stopped at [[Windy Station]], Mimi and his sisters were seen having ice cream cones that resembled Vanillite. They were delighted to see Malin's {{p|Vanillite}} handing out some {{b|Oran}} Ice to the group.

He and his family made a cameo during the ending credits of ''[[M16|Genesect and the Legend Awakened]]'', where they were having a tour at [[Pokémon Hills]]. Their outfit's colors are changed and different from the ones in the previous movie.
